preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each string s must have a length between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'Yes' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s must be one of the characters in 'Yes'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(s in 'Yes' * i for i in range(1, 1001)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the string s is a substring of 'Yes' repeated many times, otherwise output 'NO'.
